questions.question: It was (a)/ the very well-directed film (b)/ and we enjoyed it.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'a' instead of 'the'. kyunki yahan movie ke baare mein first time baat hui hai sentence mein pehle iska koi zikr nahi hai. article ka meaning bhi 'ek' wala aa rha hai. 'veh ek well directed film thi'

questions.question: Brahmaputra is (a)/one of the longest rivers (b)/that originate (c)/in the Himalayas.(d)
questions.solution: Use The before Brahmaputra. River ke name se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: It was a surprising (a)/ to receive the gift (b)/ from my brother.(c)/no error (d)
questions.solution: Remove 'a'. use 'it was surprising/it was a surprise' ka use karen, kyunki article ka use noun ke liye kiya jaata hai yahan 'surprising' koi noun nahi present participle (adjective) hai.

questions.question: This is (a)/the most important (b)/question which you have (c)/to prepare very carefully.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'a' in place of 'the'. a most important question = a very important question. Yeh adverb chapter ka concept hai. 'most' ka matlab 'very' bhi hota hai. Yahan iss question ki tulna kisi aur question se nahi karni hai isliye superlative degree 'most' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: Antique diamond necklace (a)/ was stolen (b)/ from the museum.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'an' before antique diamond necklace. kyunki singular countable noun se pehle article lagate hain.

questions.question: He went for the lunch (a)/at 1 pm and then (b)/returned.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Remove the before lunch. kyunki meal ke name se pehle article use nahi karte.

questions.question: Athens was (a)/ a most luminous (b)/ of all the city-states (c)/ of ancient Greece.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the most' instead of 'a most'. kyunki yahan 'athens' ka greece ki baaki ancient cities ke sath comparison karna hai, isliye superlative degree lagegi. a most = very. the most :- superlative degree banane ke liye use hota hai.

questions.question: When the principal entered the classroom (a)/all boys shook (b)/in their shoes.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use all the boys in place of all boys. All+ the +noun = particular. All + noun = general. Yahan uss particular class ke ladkon ki baat ho rahi hai isliye 'all the boys' aayega.

questions.question: Sunil refused to (a)/ attend the meeting (b)/ of association on Saturday.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'the' before association. kyunki singular countable noun se pehle article lagate hain aur sentence ke meaning ke according yahan ek particular association ki baat ho rhi hai isliye 'the association' aayega.

questions.question: The stadium was full (a)/ of spectators (b)/ from one end to other.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use the other in place of other. Yahan meaning dena hai 'ek end se dusre end tak' toh dusra end specific hai isliye 'the other end' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Ronaldo is (a)/ a famous (b)/ player of (c)/ the football.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'the' before football. football proper noun hai 'games' ke names ke sath article nahi lagate kyunki wo generally proper noun hote hain.

questions.question: An ancient (a)/considered that (b)/knowledge had its limits.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use The ancient in place of An ancient. the rich = rich people, the blind = blind people, ese hi. the ancient = ancient people (purvaz)

questions.question: There was an interesting article (a)/ in the newspaper (b)/ about the dangers (c)/to an environment.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the environment' instead of 'an environment'. kyunki environment, atmosphere, sky, etc. ek hi hain isliye wo sabke liye same hain (speaker and listener dono ke liye) isliye unke pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The scientist was awarded (a) / with an honorary doctorate for (b) / his groundbreaking research in (c) / field of molecular biology. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'the field' instead of 'field'. Yahan noun of noun ka structure ban raha hai. 'Field' noun ko specific kia gaya hai aage phrase laga ke isliye yahan 'the' article ka use hoga. Note - 'an honorary doctorate' me koi dikkat nahi hai kyunki yahan pe ye first time introduce hua hai tho yahan pe Indefinite article hi lagega aur 'H' isme silent hai isliye 'a' article nhi aayega. Article 'an' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The sea has become (a)/ an cheap dumping ground (b)/ for all kinds (c)/ of waste products.(d)
questions.solution: use 'a' instead of 'an' before cheap. kyunki article 'an' ka use vowel sounding words se pehle ke liye kiya jaata hai jabki article 'a' ka use consonant sounding words se pehle kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The accelerating pace of life in our metropolitan city (a)/ has had the tremendous effect (b)/ on the culture and life-style of the people.(c) no error (d)
questions.solution: Use a tremendous effect in place of the tremendous effect. Yahan tremendous effect ka jikr first time kiya gya hai aur article ka meaning 'ek' wala aa rha hai. Culture pe ek tremendous effect. Isliye 'a tremendous effect' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Four of earliest civilisations (a)/ of the world (b)/ were located (c)/ on the banks of or near large rivers.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' before earliest. kyunki superlative degree se pehle definite article 'the' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Do you mind (a)/ lending me (b)/ your book (c)/ for a hour?(d)
questions.solution: use 'an' instead of 'a'. kyunki article 'an' ka use vowel sounding words se pehle ke liye kiya jaata hai jabki article 'a' ka use consonant sounding words se pehle kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He has taught (a)/ me how to play (b)/ flute (c)/ without taking much time.(d)
questions.solution: Use the flute in place of flute. musical instruments ke name se pehle 'the' article ka use karte hain.

questions.question: The captain (a)/ scored a century (b)/ in a (c)/ second innings.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' instead of 'a'. kyunki second ek ordinal hai aur iske use se 'innings' noun specific ho gya isliye 'the second innings' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He is not that (a)/kind of a person who (b)/ will go back on his words.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'kind of person' in place of 'kind of a person'. 'kind/type/sort + of + noun' is structure mein noun se pehle article ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: Whole country (a)/ applauded the (b)/ courage of (c)/our soldiers.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' before 'whole' generally. whole adjective se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai kyunki ye kisi definite cheez ki complete quantity ko refer karta hai.

questions.question: Children enjoy listening to (a)/ ghost stories (b)/ especially on Halloween night.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use The Halloween night in place of Halloween night. Yahan 'special night' ki baat ho rahi hai jaise on the diwali night, on the Christmas night, on the Halloween night. Note:- Halloween angrezon ke ek festival ka naam hai.

questions.question: When I met Akbar Padamsee,(a)/ one of a pioneers of Indian art, (b)/ he was 87 (c)/ but still alert and active.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' instead of 'a'. kyunki yahan 'pioneers' plural noun hai iske sath 'a' ka use nahi kiya jaa sakta hai, aur yahan 'pioneers' specific noun hai isliye definite article 'the' ka use karenge.

questions.question: On my request, (a)/ Navendera introduced me (b)/ to his girl friend (c)/ who is a singer and a dancer.(d)
questions.solution: Use a singer and dancer in place of a singer and a dancer. ek hi person ko refer karne ke liye jab 2 nouns likhe jayen toh article sirf pehle wale ke sath lagate hain.

questions.question: Most of voters (a)/ in Taiwan seem to have (b)/ once again voted for (c)/ the democratic party and President Tsai Ing-wen.(d)
questions.solution: use 'Most of the voters in taiwan' in place of 'most of voters in taiwan'. kyunki yahan 'voters' specific hain 'taiwan ke voters' isliye definite article 'the' ka use krenge.

questions.question: Gold (a)/ of South Africa (b)/ is exported to many countries.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use The gold in place of Gold. Yahan specific type ke gold ki baat ho rahi hai.

questions.question: I think Virat Kohli will remain (a)/ the captain (b)/ of the Indian team (c)/ in a year 2020.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' instead of 'a'. Yahan inn dono mein se koi bhi structure likh sakte hain 'in 2020' or 'in the year 2020'. Agar sirf '2020' hoga toh wo apne aap mein proper noun ho jayega toh koi article nhi ayega but agar 'year 2020' likhenge to yahan 'year' jo ek common noun hai wo definite ho rha isliye definite article 'the' ka use karenge.

questions.question: The honesty (a)/ is one of the most essential qualities (b)/ for anyone to get respect in society.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Remove the before honesty. kyunki 'honesty' ek abstract noun hai jo yahan generalised sense mein use ho rha hai isliye isse pehle kisi article ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: We were busy (a)/ at the work (b)/ and went for lunch (c)/ only at 3:00 pm.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'the'. kyunki 'at work/home' ye kuchh ek fix phrases hain. Note :- ese fix phrases ka reading se hi pta chalta hai inka koi grammar ka logic nahi hai.

questions.question: Kalidasa lived long before (a)/Shakespeare so Shakespeare should (b)/have been known as Kalidasa of England.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use the Kalidasa of England in place of Kalidas of England. Kyunki yahan 'kalidasa' ko proper noun ki tarah nahi common noun ki tarah use kiya gya aur 'of England' phrase ki wajah se wo specific ho gya isliye 'the kalidasa' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The Prime Minister is holding the (a)/ important meeting to review the security and safety of the doctors (b)/ working in (c)/ government hospitals.(d)
questions.solution: use 'an important meeting' instead of 'the important meeting'. kyunki yahan meeting ki baat first time ki gayi hai aur meaning bhi 'ek important meeting' nikal raha hai isliye 'the' nahi 'an' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: He said (a)/that he did not feel (b)/any need to discuss (c)/the episode in the detail.(d)
questions.solution: Use in detail in place of in the detail. 'in detail' ek fix phrase hai. Note:- ese fix phrases ka reading se hi pata chalta hai inka koi grammar ka logic nahi hai.

questions.question: Does an (a)/English examination (b)/ begin at (c)/ 10 o'clock?(d)
questions.solution: use 'the English examination' instead of 'an English examination'. kyunki sentence ke meaning se pata chal raha hai ki puchhne wala kisi 'particular examination' ka 'time' puchh rha hai. Meaning se yeh baat clear hai ki 'speaker' aur 'listener' dono ko yeh pata hai ki kis exam ki baat ho rhi hai isliye 'the english examination' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He boasts of (a)/having good knowledge (b)/of mathematics but everybody (c)/knows how far he is good at mathematics.(d)
questions.solution: Use a good knowledge in place of good knowledge. waise toh 'knowledge' uncountable noun hai but iske sath 'a good' phrase ka use allowed hai quantity ko refer karne ke liye, jaise 'a lot of/ a plenty of' etc. phrases ka use quantity ko dikhane ke liye hota hai yahan 'a good knowledge' ka meaning hai 'kaafi knowledge'

questions.question: To write (a)/ a poem I need (b)/ a pen, a diary (c)/ and also the quiet place.(d)
questions.solution: use 'a quiet place' instead of 'the quiet place'. kyunki yahan iss place ki baat first time hui hai aur meaning bhi nikal raha hai 'ek quiet place'.

questions.question: When the house was (a)/set on the fire, all the people (b)/started crying at the top (c)/of their voices.(d)
questions.solution: Use set on fire in place of set on the fire. set on fire - kisi cheez ko aag laga dena. Aur 'fire' noun ka use jab general aag wale meaning mein karte hain toh yeh uncountable hota hai aur iske sath koi article nahi lagate.

questions.question: Due to a last minute snag, (a)/ the mission (b)/ on a moon (c)/ had to be cancelled.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' instead of 'a'. kyunki 'celestial body' se pehle 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I don't like (a)/that type of a man (b)/who does nothing but (c)/find out faults with others.(d)
questions.solution: Use type of man in place of type of a man. kind/type/sort + of + noun is structure mein noun se pehle article ka use nahi karte

questions.question: With this (a)/ heat wave going on, (b)/ we are experiencing (c)/ a terrible weather.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'a'. kyunki 'weather' ek uncountable noun hai, aur uncountable noun ke pehle 'a/an' ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: In 2016 after some unseemly back-and-forth (a)/ to the commons and Lords, (b)/ it was decided (c)/ that Acts of Parliament should no longer be printed on calfskin.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the' before lords. Jaise humare India mein parliament ke 2 houses hain waise hi Britain ki parliament ke 2 houses hain jinko 'the commons' and 'the lords' kehte hain.

questions.question: Tesla designed system (a)/ for sending electricity (b)/ over the air (c)/ through a series of enormous towers.(d)
questions.solution: use 'a' before system. kyunki 'singular countable noun' bina article ke use nahi kiya jaata.

questions.question: After knowing truth,(a)/ the jury took the right decision (b)/ in the case.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'knowing the truth' instead of 'knowing truth'. Truth (sachchai) ek hi hoti hai isliye usse specific maan kr uske sath 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Aniket lives (a)/ in the small apartment (b)/ in the suburbs.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'a small apartment' instead of 'the small apartment'. kyunki yahan 'apartment' ki baat first time hui hai aur meaning bhi 'ek small apartment' aa rha hai.

questions.question: The present-century threats to our environment, (a)/ which include interfering species, ailments, pollution and (b)/ a boiling temperature, were putting wildlife populations at peril.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'a' and replace 'were putting' with 'are putting'. yahan 2 mistakes hain. 1st :- remove 'a' before boiling temperature. kyunki yahan 'temperature' uncountable noun hai. 2nd error :- meaning ke according present tense use karna padega isliye 'were putting' ki jagah 'are putting' hoga.

questions.question: Sky appears blue (a)/ as it absorbs (b)/ all colours and (c)/ reflects only blue.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'the' article before sky. kyunki sky, atmosphere, environment ye esi cheezen hain jo 'speaker' aur 'listener' dono ke liye ek hi hoti hain yaani 'obvious/same/specific' hoti hain isliye inse pehle 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: It was (a)/ by a chance (b)/ he saw a movie in a theatre.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use by chance instead of by a chance. kyunki 'by chance' ek fixed phrase hai. Note :- ese fix phrases ka reading se hi pta chalta hai inka koi grammar ka logic nahi hai.

questions.question: You can fool some of the people all the time, (a)/ and all the people some of the time; (b)/ but you cannot fool all the people all the time.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: No error. Note :- yeh sentence kisi ko dhokadhadi ke kaam chhodne ke liye advice ke roop mein bola gya hai aur iska meaning yeh hai ki:- Tum kuchh logon ko toh humesha bewakoof bana sakte ho aur sab logon ko kabhi-kabhar lekin tum sab logon ko har baar bewakoof nahi bana sakte ho.

questions.question: She was waiting (a)/ for a opportunity (b)/to start her (c)/ own business.(d)
questions.solution: Use an in place of a. kyunki vowel sound ke pehle 'a' nahi 'an' lagta hai.

questions.question: This will be most difficult of (a)/ the adjustments we have to make (b)/ because we have been used to (c)/ spending a lot on guests.(d)
questions.solution: Use the before most. superlative degree se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Maruti likes (a)/ adventure (b)/ stories, especially (c)/ an adventures of Tarzan. (d)
questions.solution: Use the adventures of Tarzan instead of an adventures of Tarzan. Adventures noun plural hai iske sath 'an' article nahi aayega. Note:- 'adventures of Tarzan' yeh ek novel ka name hai isme 'the' article already author ne laga rakha hai title mein toh yahi manna padega. Esa ek aur example bhi previous papers mein aa chuka hai - 'the arabian nights'

questions.question: Anti-party activities (a)/ improved my relations (b)/with an opposition.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'the opposition' in place of 'an opposition'. the ruling party - satta paksha, the opposition- vipaksha, yeh dono specific hote hain isliye inse pehle 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I love (a)/ to read certain (b)/ stories from (c)/ a Mahabharata.(d)
questions.solution: Use the mahabharata in place of a mahabharata. epics or holy books ke naam se pehle 'the' article lagta hai.

questions.question: The more he (a)/ got to know her, (b)/more he got (c)/ attracted to her.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the more' instead of 'more'. kyunki gradual increase decrease ko dikhane wale structure mein dono clause se pehle 'the comparative' ka use karte hain.

questions.question: The president rewarded (a)/ that soldier for (b)/ an exceptional bravery (c)/ that he showed in the war.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the exceptional bravery' instead of 'an exceptional bravery'. Note:- waise generally toh 'bravery' ek abstract noun hota hai iske sath general sense mein koi article use nahi karte par yahan us exceptional bravery ki baat ho rhi hai jo uss soldier ne war mein dikhayi thi isliye yahan bravery specific ho gya.

questions.question: The student ought to (a)/ respect his (b)/ teachers and should (c)/ be obedient.(d)
questions.solution: use 'A student' instead of 'the student'. kyunki yahan kisi 'specific student' ki nahi balki ek general student ki baat ho rhi hai. Note:- bhale hi yahan meaning ke according 'a student' all student ko refer kar raha hai par ye subject grammar ke according singular hi hai isliye verb etc. singular hi aayenge.

questions.question: The moon is Earth's only natural satellite and the nearby large celestial body.
questions.solution: 'the' articles se hint mil rha hai ki superlative degree ka use hoga aur yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'sabke pass ki large celestial body'. Obviously moon largest celestial body nhi hai isliye A option galat hai. D option - 'Nearly large' means lagbhag large jo ki meaning se galat hai. Isliye B option meaning and grammar ke according sahi hai.

questions.question: It was an horrible day at the office for Roy, but he didn't allow it to spoil his evening plans.
options: was a horrible day at the office
were a horrible day at office
questions.solution: yahan 'It' introductory subject hai aur 'day' real subject hai isliye verb singular ayegi aur 'a' article sahi hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article
options: Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above a catchment area such as an river, reservoir or an lake.
Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above a catchment area such as a river, reservoir or a lake
Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above an catchment area such as a river, reservoir or an lake.
Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above an catchment area such as a river, reservoir or a lake
questions.solution: 'catchment area' and 'river' dono mein consonant sound hai isliye 'a' article ka use hoga isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The BBC has a wonderful series on a emergence of women novelists in English literature.
questions.solution: yahan 'emergence of women novelists' me 'noun of noun' ka structure create ho rha hai isliye 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: The apple a day keeps the doctor away.
questions.solution: Apple se pehle 'an' article ayega aur 'a day' means 'per day' isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: I have an invite from a friend to visit the Canada and United States next month.
options: to Canada or the united states
to the Canada and United States
questions.solution: jo country alag se country se mil ke banti hai uske name se pehle 'the' article atta hai jaise 'the united states of America' but canada se pehle 'the' nhi ayega isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct statement from among the given options.
options: It is a nice party. I am enjoying the party.
It is a party. I am enjoying an party.
It is party. I am enjoying a party.
It is the party. I am enjoying an party.
questions.solution: First sentence mein 'party' ko first time introduce kiya gya hai aur ye singular countable hai isliye 'a' article ka use hoga. 2nd sentence mein same party ki baat ho rhi hai isliye 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The Supriya is the best girl in the class.
Supriya is the best girl in the class.
Supriya is best girl in the class.
The Supriya is a best girl in the class.
questions.solution: Supriya proper noun hai iss se pehle 'the' article nhi ayega aur 'best' superlative degree se pehle 'the' ayega isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: It is a old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
It is old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
It is the old uniform but memorable thing for me.
It is an old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
questions.solution: 'old' mein vowel sound hai aur 'old uniform' ko first time introduce kiya gaya hai isliye 'an old uniform' yani D option sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The rider who met with an accident was not wearing an helmet, the police said.
A rider who met with the accident was not wearing the helmet, an police said.
The rider who met with the accident was not wearing a helmet, the police said.
The rider who met with a accident was not wearing a helmet, the police said.
questions.solution: Yahan meaning ke according 'rider' and 'accident' specific hai but 'helmet' general hai isliye 'rider' and 'accident' se pehle 'the' article and 'helmet' se pehle 'a' article ayega.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
A decision to change a hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
The decision to change a hospital saved an life of the daughter of the doctor.
The decision to change an hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
questions.solution: Yahan particular 'decision' hai kisi particular 'hospital' ko change karne ke liye dono se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: An warrior was waiting for a right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave.
The warrior was waiting for a right time to attack an lion hiding in the cave.
The warrior was waiting for the right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave.
The warrior was waiting for an right time to attack the lion hiding in a cave.
questions.solution: 'Warrior', 'lion' and 'right time' se pehle 'an' article nhi ayega isliye A, B and D options galat hain. Meaning and grammar ke according C option sahi hai

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: As a nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.
As nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.
As the nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.
As a nation, India is an united country and shall always remain so.
questions.solution: yahan meaning dena hai 'Ek nation ke hisab se India..' isliye nation se pehle 'a' article ka use hoga aur 'united' mein consonant sound hai isliye 'a' article ka use hoga. isliye A option sahi hai. Note:- university, union, unique, united etc inn sabke shuru mein consonant sound hai naki vowel sound.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: It was the hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchase and the couple of meetings.
It was a hectic day for Susan with the lot of purchase and a couple of meetings.
It was a hectic day for Susan with the lot of purchase and an couple of meetings.
It was a hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchases and a couple of meetings
questions.solution: yahan 'hectic day' first time introduce ho rha hai isliye 'a' article ka use hoga aur quantity ko show karne ke liye 'a lot of purchases (plural) sahi hai isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: The gold is a very precious metal because it is used to make ornaments.
questions.solution: yahan 'gold' material noun generalized sense mein use kiya gaya hai isliye iss se pehle koi article nhi ayega.

questions.question: He met European lady at the conference who works for an NGO.
options: a European lady at the conference
an European lady at the conference
questions.solution: yahan 'lady' singular countable noun isliye article ayega aur European mein consonant sound hai isliye 'a' article ayega. Isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The more they earn, more they spend on luxury items.
options: the more they ought to spend
questions.solution: gradual increase decrease ko dikhane ke liye 'the + comparative degree' ka use hota hai. aur meaning ke according yahan B option best hai.

questions.question: Kalidasa is known as the Shakespeare of India.
questions.solution: yahan 'Shakespeare' proper noun ko common noun ki tarah use kiya ja rha hai aur noun of noun ka structure ban rha hai isliye Shakespeare se pehle 'the' article ka use sahi kiya gya tha question mein.

questions.question: The practice of starving children who have diarrhoea can also worsen the situation.
questions.solution: 'Children' already plural hota hai isliye C option galat hai. D option galat hai kyuki 'of' preposition ke baad gerund ayega. yhan particular children ki baat ho rhi hai jinko diarrhoea ho isliye children se pehle 'the' article ayega isliye B galat hai aur A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Amazon is (a)/ considered the largest river (b)/ in terms of water discharge (c)/ in the world. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'amazon'. Sentence mein 'the' article ayega kyunki 'river, celestial bodies, monuments, mythological books etc.' ke naam ke sath 'the' article ka use hota hai, 'amazon' river ka naam hai, isliye isse pehle 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: It was a most amazing (a)/ experience for us to travel through the (b)/ mountains at night. (c) No error (d)
questions.solution: No error

questions.question: Old silver coin having very strange (a)/ carvings was discovered (b)/ by the archaeologists (c)/ during the excavation. (d)
questions.solution: put 'an' article before 'old silver coin'. Sentence mein 'old silver coin' ek singular countable noun hai jiske pehle article ka use hota hai, 'old' vowels sound ka word hai, isliye isse pehle 'an' article sahi hoga. 'a' article ka use consonant sound ke word se pehle karte hai.

questions.question: All of us (a)/ had the dinner together and (b)/ enjoyed the evening. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' article before 'dinner'. Sentence mein 'the' article nhi ayega kyunki meal ke naam se pehle article ka use nahi hota.

questions.question: This car is (a)/ a most expensive model (b)/ of all the vehicles (c)/ launched by the company this year. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'a' with 'the'. Sentence mein ek car ke model ka comparison baaki sabhi car ke model se hua hai, jab ek cheez ka comparison baaki sabse ho toh superlative degree ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'a' article ki jagah par 'the' article ayega, toh 'the most expensive model' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the captain (a)/ gave the final command (b)/ all soldiers marched towards (c)/ the battlefield with determination. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'soldier'. Sentence mein 'captain' ke under jitne soldier honge unhe hee command dega, naa ki saare soldier jo har jagah hai, toh yahan 'soldier' specific honge, isliye yahan soldier se pehle 'the' specific article use hoga, isliye 'all the soldiers' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Priya decided (a)/ to donate some money (b)/ to fund the activities (c)/ of association working for animal welfare. (d)
questions.solution: put 'an/the' article before 'association'. Sentence mein 'association' single countable noun hai jisse pehle article chaiye, agar kisi specific 'association' ki baat ho rahi hai, toh 'the' article ayega, aur agar ek association ki baat karni hai toh 'an' article ayega.

questions.question: The bridge stretched (a)/ from one side of the river (b)/ to other (c)/ without any visible support. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'other'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'bridge stretch karta hai river ke ek taraf se dusri taraf', toh river ki do side hoti hai dono specific hoti hai, isliye yahan 'other' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga. Isliye 'to the other' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The pilot announced (a)/ that there would be turbulence (b)/ due to heavy winds in (c)/ sky ahead. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'sky'. Sentence mein 'sky' se pehle 'the' article ayega kyunki 'sky, river, mountains, celestial bodies etc.' yeh specific hoti hai jinse pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai, isliye 'the sky ahead' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The students decorated the hall (a)/ beautifully to hold a function (b)/ in an honour of their headmistress (c)/ who was retiring this month. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'an honour' with 'honour'. 'In honour of somebody' ek fixed idiomatic expression hai aap google karke isko check kar sakte hai aisa lagega ki yahan pe specific honour ki baat ho rahi hai tho 'the' article laga dena chahiye lekin kyunki ye ek fixed idiomatic expression hai english grammar me isliye better option 'In honour of' hi hai.

questions.question: He prepared (a)/ the strong cup of coffee (b)/ to stay awake (c)/ while completing his project at night. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the strong' with 'a strong'. Sentence mein 'strong cup of coffee' koi specific baat nahi hai, iska generally matlab hai 'usne ek strong coffee banayi raat ko jagne ke liye', toh 'ek' ke sense ke liye 'strong' se pehle 'a' article sahi hoga, isliye 'a strong cup of coffee' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The heavy rainfall this year (a)/ has had the serious effect (b)/ on the production of wheat and rice (c)/ in northern states. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the serious' with 'a serious'. Sentence mein 'serious effect' koi specific nahi hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'heavy rainfall ka ek serious effect', toh yahan 'ek' ka sense dena hai, isliye 'a' singular article sahi hoga, isliye 'a serious effect' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This is (a)/a most expensive painting (b)/ ever displayed (c)/ in the National art museum. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'a most' with 'the most'. Sentence ka matlab 'yeh painting sabse expensive painting jo abhi tak museum mein lagi hai', toh yahan ek ka comparison baaki sab se karna hai jiske liye superlative degree ka use hota hai, jisme 'the' article ka use hota hai, isliye 'the most expensive painting' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The doctor will see you (a)/ after a hour (b)/ as he is currently attending (c)/ another patient in the emergency ward. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'a hour' with 'an hour'. 'an' article ka use vowels sound words se pehle hota hai, jabki 'a' article ka use consonant sound ke words se pehle, toh 'hour' ek vowel sound word hai, isliye 'an hour' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I couldn't believe that (a)/ she learned how to play piano (b)/ when she was just six years old (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'piano'. 'piano' se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga kyunki 'musical instruments' se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai, isliye 'the piano' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The student received (a)/ a prize (b)/ for his excellent performance (c)/ in first test of the term. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'first'. Sentence mein 'first' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga kyunki ordinal adjective 'first, second, third' se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai, isliye 'the first' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: That's the (a)/ sort of a behaviour (b)/ which can ruin (c)/ our team's reputation. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'a' before 'behaviour'. 'behaviour' se pehle 'a' article ka use nahi hoga kyunki 'type of, sort of, kind of' inke words ke baad article ka use nahi karte, isliye 'sort of behaviour' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Whole country (a)/ mourned deeply (b)/ after hearing the tragic news (c)/ of the national hero's death. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'whole'. Sentence mein 'whole' se pehle 'the' article use hoga kyunki sentence mein kisi specific country ki baat ho rahi hai jahan 'death' hui hogi, isliye yahan 'the whole country' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: People light hundreds of lamps (a)/ and decorate their homes beautifully (b)/ on Diwali night (c)/ to celebrate the victory of light over darkness. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'diwali night'. Sentence mein 'night' noun hai aur 'diwali' ek adjective ki tarah likha hai, waise 'diwali, holi, Christmas etc.' festival se pehle article ka use nahi karte, lekin sentence mein 'diwali' ka use 'night' ke pehle likhe hone se wo 'night' specific ho gayi, isliye yahan 'diwali' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga, isliye 'the diwali night' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She was honoured as (a)/ one of a pioneers of women empowerment (b)/ during the international conference (c)/ held in New Delhi last year. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'a pioneers' with 'the pioneers'. Sentence mein 'women empowerment' ke 'pioneers' ki baat ho rahi hai, toh yahan 'pioneers' specific hai, isliye yahan 'pioneers' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga, isliye 'the pioneers' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Mr. Kapoor, (a)/ who is a businessman and a philanthropist, (b)/ donated a large sum (c)/ to build a hospital for underprivileged people. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'a' before 'philanthropist'. Sentence mein 'businessman' aur 'philanthropist' waali baat 'mr. kapoor' ke liye likhi hai, agar ek person ke liye do noun likhte hai, toh baad waale noun ke sath article ka use nahi hota, isliye yahan 'philanthropist' se pehle 'a' article ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: Most of citizens in Japan (a)/ prefer using public transportation (b)/ because it is more convenient and punctual (c)/ than owning a private vehicle. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'citizens'. Sentence mein particular 'japan' ke citizens ki baat ho rahi hai, toh yahan 'citizens' specific hai, isliye yahan 'citizens' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga, isliye 'most of the citizens' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Tea (a)/ of Darjeeling (b)/ has a unique aroma and flavour (c)/ which distinguishes it from other varieties across the globe. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'tea'. Sentence mein particular 'darjeeling' ki 'tea' ki baat ho rahi, toh yahan 'tea' noun specific hai, isliye yahan 'tea' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga, isliye 'the tea' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The company has planned (a)/ to launch its new electric vehicle (b)/ across all the major cities of India (c)/ in an year. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'an year' with 'a year'. Sentence mein 'year' se pehle 'a' article ayega kyunki 'consonants' sound se pehle 'a' article ka use hota hai aur 'vowels' sound se pehle 'an' article ka, 'year' ki sahi pronunciation consonant sound se hai, isliye 'a year' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The patience (a)/ is the key to success (b)/ when dealing with (c)/ difficult and stressful situations in life. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' before 'patience'. Sentence mein 'patience' abstract noun hai aur yahan koi specific 'patience' ki baat nahi ho rahi, 'patience' ke baare mein general baat ho rahi hai 'patience safalta ki koonji hai', isliye yahan 'patience' se pehle 'the' article ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: She couldn't answer my call (a)/ because she was busy at the home (b)/ preparing dinner for the guests (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' before 'home'. Sentence mein 'home' se pehle 'the' nahi ayega, generally bahut phrase aise hote hai jo particular type mein likhe jaate hai, jaise 'at home' likha jata hai, aur yeh cheezein reading se clear hogi, isliye 'at home' sabse sahi answer hoga. Yeh ek weak error ki category mein hai, agar sentence mein aur koi error hoti toh usse mark karte.

questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi (a)/ is often regarded as Lincoln of India (b)/ because of his relentless efforts (c)/ to bring justice and equality among people. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' before 'lincoln'. Sentence mein 'lincoln' proper noun hai, jab ek proper noun ko common noun ki tarah use kiya jata hai toh uske aage article ka use hota hai, aur 'lincoln' yahan specific hai, isliye isse pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga.

questions.question: The journalist (a)/ promised to cover the entire incident (b)/ in the newspaper article (c)/ in the detail to make people aware of the issue. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' before 'detail'. Sentence mein 'detail' se pehle 'the' article nahi ayega, generally bahut phrase aise hote hai jo particular type mein likhe jaate hai, jaise 'in detail' likha jata hai, aur yeh cheezein reading se clear hogi, isliye 'in detail' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I heard that an English examination (a)/ has been postponed (b)/ due to a technical issue (c)/ in the online test system. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'an english' with 'the english'. Sentence mein 'english' se pehle 'the' ayega kyunki sentence mein sirf 'english' ka exam postponed hua hai, isliye yahan 'english examination' specific hai jisse pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga, isliye 'the English examination' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The gold is considered a symbol (a)/of wealth and prosperity in many cultures, (b)/and people often invest in it to secure their future. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' before 'gold'. Sentence mein koi specific gold ki baat nahi ho rahi jaise 'gold of Karnataka etc.', sentence mein 'gold' ko generalized way mein use kiya hai aur 'gold' material noun hai jiske pehle article ka use nahi hota, isliye yahan 'gold' se pehle 'the' article ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: The writer (a)/ mentioned that he needed a candle, a notebook (b)/ and the calm place (c)/ where no one could disturb him at night. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the calm place' with 'a calm place'. Sentence mein koi specific 'calm place' ki baat nahi hui hai, general baat hui hai writer ko ek notebook, ek candle aur ek shaant jagah chaiye', isliye yahan 'the' specific article ki jagah par 'a' article ka use hoga, isliye 'a calm place' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The villagers (a)/ were shocked when they saw (b)/ that the entire barn had been set on the fire last night.(c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' before 'fire'. Sentence mein 'fire' ke pehle 'the' nahi ayega kyunki iska ek general phrase hota hai 'set on fire', jab kisi aise sense mein kaha jaaye 'kisi cheez mein aag lag gayi', toh 'fire' uncountable ke category mein aata hai, aur iske sath kisi article ka use nahi hota hai, isliye yahan 'fire' se pehle 'the' ka use nahi hoga. Note: fire ke sath article ka use ho sakta hai jab iska matlab 'they started a fire', toh kisi particular jagah pe aag lagai uss sense mein fire ke sath article ka use ho sakta hai.

questions.question: Scientists (a)/ are planning to send another rover (b)/ to collect rock samples (c)/ from moon in the coming decade. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'moon'. Sentence mein 'moon' se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga kyunki celestial bodies jaise earth, moon, sun etc. se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai, isliye 'the moon' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Because of the cyclone approaching the coast, (a)/ people are experiencing (b)/ a bad weather (c)/ with strong winds and heavy rainfall. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'a' article before 'bad weather'. Sentence mein 'bad weather' se pehle 'a' article ka use nahi hoga kyunki 'weather' uncountable noun hai jiske pehle article ka use nahi hota, isliye 'experiencing bad weather' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The scientist (a)/ developed model (b)/ to predict future earthquakes (c)/ based on seismic wave patterns. (d)
questions.solution: put 'a' article before 'model'. Sentence mein 'model' se pehle 'a' article ayega kyunki 'model' countable hai aur sentence mein iss 'model' ke baare mein bhi bataya hai, isliye 'a model' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Once the students realised truth (a)/ behind the sudden fee hike, (b)/ they protested peacefully (c)/ demanding justice from the administration. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' before 'truth'. Generally 'truth' se pehle 'the' article ka use hota kyunki 'truth' specific hota hai, isliye 'the truth' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It was (a)/ by a chance (b)/ that she met her childhood friend (c)/ while travelling on a train to Delhi. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'a' article before 'chance'. 'chance' se pehle 'a' nahi ayega kyunki 'by chance' ek general phrase hai, jiske sath article use nahi hota, isliye 'by chance' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The teachers (a)/ are responsible for shaping (b)/ the character and values (c)/ of the young minds in every society. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'the' before 'teachers'. Sentence mein 'teachers' noun specific nahi hai, yeh ek general taur pe bataya ki teacher responsible hoti hai character aur values ke liye young minds mein, toh yahan 'teachers' noun specific nahi hai, isliye isse pehle 'the' article ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: During the debate (a)/ the prime minister addressed (b)/ several questions raised (c)/ by an opposition regarding foreign policies. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'an opposition' with 'the opposition'. Sentence mein 'opposition' se pehle 'the' ayega kyunki 'ruling party' ek hee hoti hai aur baaki jitni bhi parties hoti hai un sabhi ko opposition kaha jata hai, jiske kaaran opposition specific ho jata hai, isliye 'opposition' se pehle 'the' specific article ka use hota hai, isliye 'the opposition' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She packed her bags (a)/ in the hurry (b)/ and booked the next available flight (c)/ after hearing the news of her father's accident. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the hurry' with 'a hurry'. Generally 'hurry' se pehle 'a' article ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'a hurry' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The less you (a)/ worry about what others think, (b)/ more peaceful (c)/ your life will eventually become. (d)
questions.solution: put 'the' article before 'more peaceful'. Sentence mein gradual increase/decrease ka structure follow ho raha hai jisme dono clause mein comparative degree ke sath 'the' article ka use hota hai, jaise 'the higher you go, the cooler it is', 'the more you practice, the stronger you become'. Waise he sentence mein 'more' se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga, isliye 'the more peaceful' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The audience stood (a)/ and clapped for several minutes (b)/ to appreciate an outstanding bravery (c)/ shown by the young boy who saved his friend from drowning. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'an outstanding' with 'the outstanding'. Sentence mein 'bravery' specific hai jo uss ladke ne dikhai apne friend ko doobne se bachane ke waqt, kyunki 'bravery' specific hai, isliye isse pehle 'the' specific article ka use hoga, isliye 'the outstanding bravery' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The manager believes that (a)/ the employee must (b)/ follow the company's rules (c)/ and work with full dedication to succeed. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the employee' with 'an employee'. Sentence mein manager ke maane waali baat kisi specific employee ke liye nahi balki saare employees ke liye likhi hai, isliye yahan 'the' specific article ki jagah par 'an' article ka use hoga. jab koi baat sab pr valid hoti hai toh, usse plural mein yaa 'a,an' article ke sath likhte hai, isliye yahan 'employees' yaa 'an employee' dono sahi honge.

questions.question: It was an unforgettable evening at the concert that left everyone amazed.
options: was a unforgettable evening at the concert
were an unforgettable evening at concert
was the unforgettable evening at concert
questions.solution: No substitution.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article.
options: The scientist proposed experiment in an unique environment such as a cave or an underground lab.
The scientist proposed an experiment in a unique environment such as a cave or an underground lab.
The scientist proposed a experiment in an unique environment such as a cave or an underground lab.
The scientist proposed an experiment in a unique environment such as an cave or an underground lab.
questions.solution: Option A nahi hoga kyunki 'experiment' se pehle article ka use nahi hua. Option C bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'experiment' vowels sound ka word hai jiske sath 'an' article ka use hota hai. Option D bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'cave' consonant sound ka word hai jiske sath 'a' article ka use hota hai, isliye option D bhi nahi hoga.

questions.question: The travel agency offers exciting packages to the Brazil and the United Arab Emirates for both leisure and business travelers.
options: Brazil and the United Arab Emirates
The Brazil and United Arab Emirates
Brazil and the United Arab Emirates
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'brazil' se pehle 'the' nahi ayega kyunki aise countries jo countries ki grouping se bani hai unke sath 'the' articles ka use hota hai jaise 'the USA, the USSR, the UAE', kyunki 'brazil' koi grouping country nahi hai, isliye isse pehle 'the' article nahi ayega aur 'UAE' se pehle 'the' article ayega. Toh diye gaye options mein se option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct statement from among the given options.
options: It is a beautiful movie. I can watch the movie again with my friends.
It is the beautiful movie. I can watch a movie again with my friends.
It is an beautiful movie. I can watch the movie again with my friends.
It is a beautiful movie. I can watch an movie again with my friends.
questions.solution: Option C aur D nahi honge kyunki 'beautiful' aur 'movie' consonant sound ke words hai jinke pehle 'a' article ka use hoga, isliye option C aur D galat honge. Sentence ka kehne ka matlab hai 'yeh ek acchi movie hai, mai isse dusri baar bhi dekh sakta hoo', toh Jab movie ke baare mein dusri baar bataya jayega toh wo movie specific ho jayegi, isliye dusri baar movie se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga, isliye dusri option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The effort to clean the park helped the community to restore a beauty of its surroundings.
A effort to clean the park helped the community to restore the beauty of its surroundings.
The effort to clean the park helped the community to restore the beauty of its surroundings.
The effort to clean an park helped the community to restore the beauty of the surroundings.
questions.solution: Option D nahi hoga kyunki 'park' consonant sound ka word hai jisse pehle 'a' articke use hota hai. Option B bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'effort' ek vowel sound ka word hai jisse pehle 'an' yaa 'the' article ka use hoga. Sentence mein 'park ki surrounding ki beauty ki baat ki gayi hai', toh yahan 'beauty' specific ho jayegi, isliye isse pehle 'the' article ka use hoga. Toh option A bhi galat hoga. Option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: As a European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
As an European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
As the European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
As European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
questions.solution: Option B nahi hoga kyunki 'european' ek consonant sound ka word hai jisse pehle 'a' article ka use hota hai. Option D mein 'european' adjective hai 'country' single countable noun hai jiske pehle article ka use hoga, isliye option D bhi galat hoga. Option C bhi galat hoga kyunki European country sirf akeli 'france' nahi hai, baaki bahut European country bhi hai, isliye 'european' se pehle 'the' article galat hoga. sentence ka matlab hai 'ek European country ke taur par france major role play karta hai', toh 'france' ek European country hai, isliye 'european country' se pehle 'a' article ka use sabse sahi hoga, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: It was the tiring day for Rahul with the lot of tasks and the couple of phone calls.
It was a tiring day for Rahul with a lot of tasks and a couple of phone calls.
It was a tiring day for Rahul with a lot of task and an couple of phone calls.
It was the tiring day for Rahul with a lot of tasks and the couple of phone calls.
questions.solution: Option C galat hoga kyunki 'a lot of' ke baad 'task' noun plural aayega. Option A bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'lot of' ke pehle 'the' article ka use nahi hota. Aur sentence ka matlab hai 'ki wo ek thaakaane waala din tha', toh 'ek' wala meaning chaiye, isliye option B 'it was a tiring day' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: A wolf cannot protect another wolf against a stronger rival in the wild.
Wolf cannot protect wolf against stronger rival in the wild.
The wolf cannot protect a wolf against stronger rival in the wild.
A wolf cannot protect a wolf against a stronger rival in wild.
questions.solution: Option B nahi hoga kyunki 'wolf' singular countable noun hai jiske sath article 'a' ka use hoga. option C bhi nahi hoga kyunki koi specific wolf ki baat nahi ho rahi, isliye 'the' specific article ka use nahi hoga. sentence mein dusre wolf ke baare mein baat karenge toh 'another' ka use karna padega, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The harder he works, more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
The harder he works, the more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
The hard he works, the more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
The hard he works, more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: Rabindranath Tagore is known as the Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
Rabindranath Tagore is known as Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
Rabindranath Tagore is known as a Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
Rabindranath Tagore is known as like Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.

questions.question: The practice of feeding poors during festive seasons is a noble act appreciated by everyone.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'of' preposition ke baad 'feeding' preposition ka object(gerund) banega. Isliye option A aur D galat honge. Aur saare gareeb ke liye meaning chaiye jo ki 'the + adjective' se ayega, isliye 'feeding the poor' option C sabse sahi answer hoga.
